menu_install_red_keyboard_desc: Applies device keybox to pass integrity checks.
menu_setup_target_desc: Sets the list of applications for which keybox will be used.
menu_clear_google_services_desc: Stops Google services and clears their cache/data to reset state.
menu_setup_pif_desc: Updates device fingerprint for Play Integrity Fix.
menu_install_security_patch_desc: Sets the actual security patch date in the system.
advance_fix_detect_recovery_desc: Hides traces of custom recovery from verification apps.
advance_set_verified_boot_desc: Sets the correct boot hash to pass boot verification.
advance_enable_monitoring_desc: Starts background check and automatic keybox update on schedule.
advance_disable_monitoring_desc: Stops the background keybox monitoring service.
advance_monitoring_status_desc: Shows daemon status, check interval, and keybox.xml file.
